QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_14

question.text: Which of the following is a Regulation 27 record-keeping requirement for a Cat III AIF?

answer.text: All material contracts of investee companies
Effective rate of return for every investor

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 27 requires the Manager/Sponsor to maintain records of (a) assets under the scheme, (b) valuation policies and practices, (c) investment strategies, (d) particulars of investors and their contribution, (e) rationale for investments made. Records are kept for 5 years after winding up. The Trap: Option A (investee-company contracts) is NOT in the Reg 27 list. Options C and D are distractor topics. The verbatim wording of Reg 27 is tested. Note: The workbook fixes the Reg 27 list and 5-year retention; specific archival or versioning workflows are not part of the syllabus.
